description: This Java class 'DefaultMessageMapperFactory' is responsible for instantiating MessageMapper objects within a connectivity mapping context. It manages loading of payload mappers via class annotations, creates mapper instances dynamically using Akka actor system's dynamic access, applies extensions, and provides registry of mappers, while also handling configuration and logging.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing MessageMapper instances, supporting dynamic loading via class annotations, extension application, and configuration management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a DefaultMessageMapperFactory with given parameters.

methods.name: mapperOf
methods.description: Provides optional MessageMapper based on mapper ID and mapping context.

methods.name: registryOf
methods.description: Creates a registry of message mappers based on provided contexts and payload definitions.

methods.name: createMessageMapperInstance
methods.description: Instantiates a message mapper based on a specified engine name, applying extensions.

methods.name: configureInstance
methods.description: Configures a MessageMapper instance with options, handling invalid configurations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare factory instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for the factory class.
